description: This PHP class 'LDAPTestService' extends 'LDAPService' and provides methods to test LDAP connection and authentication using LDAP settings. It interacts with external LDAP libraries and implements logging via traits.

classes.name: LDAPTestService
classes.description: A service class for testing LDAP server connection and authentication using specified LDAP settings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the LDAPTestService with optional LDAP settings.

methods.name: getAdapter
methods.description: Returns an LDAP Adapter instance, initializing it if necessary with current LDAP settings.

methods.name: testConnection
methods.description: Attempts to bind/authenticate to LDAP using provided credentials to test connection.

methods.name: testAuthentication
methods.description: Performs LDAP connection test and returns an array indicating success or failure with messages.
